name: Incline dumbbell press

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower the dumbbells to your upper chest

phases.name: press
phases.cue: Press straight up over your shoulders

phases.name: lockout
phases.cue: Arms long, back on the pad

formTips: Set the bench to about 30–45° and sit with your back flat on the pad
Plant your feet and pinch your shoulder blades together
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your upper chest, elbows about 45–60° from your body
Press up until your arms are straight over your shoulders, without clanking the dumbbells
Keep your head, shoulders and hips on the bench
commonMistakes: Setting the bench too steep, which turns it into a shoulder press
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides
Arching off the pad to push the weight
Cutting the range short at the bottom
